caption:
Physicists are reviving the search for Nemesis, a hypothetical twin star hiding at the edge of our solar system. What if it actually exists? If a dim red or brown dwarf orbits our Sun over a light-year away, its gravitational pull could periodically disrupt the icy Oort cloud, hurling swarms of comets inward toward Earth. Detecting it would prove our solar system is a binary star system, completely changing our cosmic address. Could a dark star be lurking in deep space? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Our Sun’s Undiscovered Stellar Nemesis Is Still Out There, Says Physicist - Universe Today
